sections.title: The voice of shipowners under the Portuguese flag
sections.text: The Shipping Association of Portugal represents the majority of owners of ships registered in MAR – the International Shipping Register of Madeira – working with the Regional Government of Madeira, the IBC and industry to develop a strong Portuguese maritime cluster.

sections.title: Representing Portugal's shipping sector
sections.text: Maritime Portugal is the shipping association of Portugal. We bring together shipowners, ship managers and the wider shipping community to realise the full potential of Portuguese shipping.

objectives.title: Represent
objectives.text: Defend the interests of the Portuguese shipping sector, nationally and internationally.

objectives.title: Promote MAR
objectives.text: Contribute to the promotion of the Portuguese flag and the development of MAR, together with the IBC and the Regional Government of Madeira.

objectives.title: Develop talent
objectives.text: Create value and attract investment, companies and talent to Portuguese shipping. Support jobs and careers at sea and ashore for young Portuguese and European professionals.

objectives.title: Build the cluster
objectives.text: Foster a strong maritime cluster linking industry, academia and research. Cooperate with like-minded associations in Portugal and abroad.

sections.title: Shipowners and managers from across Europe
Want to help grow Portugal as a maritime nation?
sections.text: Join Maritime Portugal to have your voice heard with the Portuguese and Madeiran authorities and connect with fellow owners.
